files.role: [NEW] Staging-folder image import — a directly-callable shared core (scan_staging) plus a `python -m backend.import_images` CLI wrapper, structured like backend/ingest.py. Implements 10_architecture.json internal_flow steps 10 and 14: iterate /app/staging non-recursively, per file parse with Pillow, dedupe by source_sha256, exif_transpose + downscale + re-encode + metadata-strip, derive a filename slug (collision -> +6 hex of the hash), write images_dir/<slug>.<ext> then INSERT the essaycards.images row under a per-file SAVEPOINT (on INSERT failure roll back to the savepoint, unlink the file, record skipped('error'), and continue the batch). Per-file problems become skipped entries; a staging/images-dir or connection-level failure raises ImportInfraError.

public_objects.name: STAGING_DIR
public_objects.purpose: Path('/app/staging') — read-only staging mount; overridable via the scan_staging staging_dir arg for tests.

public_objects.name: IMAGES_DIR
public_objects.purpose: Path('/app/images') — app-writable processed-output mount; overridable via the scan_staging images_dir arg for tests; also imported by backend/routers/images.py for GET /images/{slug}.

public_objects.name: MAX_EDGE
public_objects.purpose: 2000 — max width/height in px before Lanczos downscale; never upscale.

public_objects.name: JPEG_QUALITY
public_objects.purpose: 82 — progressive JPEG re-encode quality.

public_objects.name: MAX_BYTES
public_objects.purpose: 5 * 1024 * 1024 — hard ceiling on a processed file; shared decision with the ck_images_byte_size CHECK in schema.sql.

public_objects.name: ACCEPT_EXTS
public_objects.purpose: {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.webp'} — case-insensitive accepted staged-file extensions.

public_objects.name: ImportInfraError
public_objects.purpose: Raised when the staging directory is unreadable or the images directory is unwritable — mapped by the endpoint to a 500 ApiError (code IMPORT_INFRA_ERROR). Not raised for per-file image problems.

public_objects.name: ImportedImage
public_objects.purpose: One successfully imported image: slug, source_filename, width (int|None), height (int|None), byte_size, content_type, stored_filename.

public_objects.name: SkippedFile
public_objects.purpose: One skipped staged file: filename, reason ('not-an-image' | 'format-mismatch' | 'gif-too-large' | 'too-large' | 'error').

public_objects.name: ImportReport
public_objects.purpose: scan_staging return value: imported (list[ImportedImage]), unchanged (int), skipped (list[SkippedFile]).

methods.name: scan_staging
methods.purpose: The one shared staging import core (internal_flow step 10). Called by POST /api/essaycards/images/scan and by the CLI wrapper. Commits each imported row under its own per-file SAVEPOINT so one file's INSERT failure is rolled back to that savepoint and recorded as a SkippedFile('error') without aborting the batch or the already-imported rows. Raises ImportInfraError only on a wholesale staging/images-dir or connection-level failure; records per-file problems as SkippedFile entries.

private_objects.name: _sha256
private_objects.purpose: Hex SHA-256 of the original staged bytes — the source_sha256 idempotency key.

private_objects.name: _slugify
private_objects.purpose: basename -> lowercase, drop extension, collapse non-[a-z0-9] runs to a single '-', trim '-'; '' -> 'image'.

private_objects.name: _resolve_slug
private_objects.purpose: Given (cur, base_slug, source_sha256): return base_slug, or base_slug + '-' + first 6 hex of source_sha256 if base_slug is already taken by a row with a different source_sha256.

private_objects.name: _process_image
private_objects.purpose: Pillow open + verify extension/format agree; ImageOps.exif_transpose; Lanczos downscale if max(dim) > MAX_EDGE; re-encode per format with metadata dropped; GIF passthrough only if byte_size <= MAX_BYTES and max(dim) <= MAX_EDGE. Returns (processed_bytes, content_type, ext, width, height) or a skip reason string.

private_objects.name: _import_one
private_objects.purpose: Process one staged file end to end inside its own SAVEPOINT: extension check, sha256 + dedupe, _process_image, _resolve_slug, write images_dir/<slug>.<ext>, INSERT the essaycards.images row, then RELEASE the SAVEPOINT and commit that row; on INSERT failure ROLLBACK TO the SAVEPOINT so psycopg2 does not abort the whole batch, unlink the file, and return ('skipped', 'error'). Already-committed rows from earlier files in the same scan stay committed and are visible to _resolve_slug. Returns an ('imported', ImportedImage) / ('unchanged', None) / ('skipped', reason) tuple.

private_objects.name: _main
private_objects.purpose: CLI wrapper for `python -m backend.import_images`: init_pool(), get_db(), scan_staging(conn), print the summary; non-zero exit on ImportInfraError. Mirrors backend/ingest.py::_main.
